segments.sn28.2:1.2: Addasā kho āyasmā ānando … pe … āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn28.2:1.3: “vippasannāni kho te, āvuso sāriputta, indriyāni; parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto.
segments.sn28.2:2.1: “Idhāhaṃ, āvuso, vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
segments.sn28.2:2.2: Tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, na evaṃ hoti –
segments.sn28.2:2.3: ‘ahaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmī’ti vā ‘ahaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpanno’ti vā ‘ahaṃ dutiyā jhānā vuṭṭhito’ti vā”ti.
segments.sn28.2:2.4: “Tathā hi panāyasmato sāriputtassa dīgharattaṃ ahaṅkāramamaṅkāramānānusayā susamūhatā.
segments.sn28.2:2.5: Tasmā āyasmato sāriputtassa na evaṃ hoti –
segments.sn28.2:2.6: ‘ahaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmī’ti vā ‘ahaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpanno’ti vā ‘ahaṃ dutiyā jhānā vuṭṭhito’ti vā”ti.

lines: 332-340. Sāriputtasaṃyuttassa paṭhame na evaṃ hotīti ahaṅkāramamaṅkārānaṃ pahīnattā evaṃ na hoti.
332-340. Na evaṃ hotīti ettha “ahaṃ samāpajjāmī”ti vā,“ahaṃ samāpanno”ti vā mā hotu tadā tādisābhogābhāvato.
Sabbathāpi na hotveva ahaṅkārassa sabbaso pahīnattā.
